+// stringToStringSliceHookFunc splits scalar string values into string slices.
+func stringToStringSliceHookFunc(from, to reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+	if from.Kind() != reflect.String || to != reflect.TypeOf([]string{}) {
+		return data, nil
+	}
+
+	fields := strings.Fields(data.(string))
+	if fields == nil {
+		return []string{}, nil
+	}
+
+	return fields, nil
+}

+func TestStringToStringSliceHookFunc(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		input  any
+		target reflect.Type
+		want   any
+	}{
+		{name: "mixed whitespace", input: " \tfoo.com  bar.com\n\tbaz.com \r\n", target: reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), want: []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"}},
+		{name: "empty string", input: "", target: reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), want: []string{}},
+		{name: "whitespace only", input: " \t\n ", target: reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), want: []string{}},
+		{name: "existing sequence", input: []string{"foo.com", "bar.com"}, target: reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), want: []string{"foo.com", "bar.com"}},
+		{name: "non-string sequence", input: []any{"foo.com", "bar.com"}, target: reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), want: []any{"foo.com", "bar.com"}},
+		{name: "non-string scalar", input: 42, target: reflect.TypeOf([]string{}), want: 42},
+		{name: "other target", input: "foo.com bar.com", target: reflect.TypeOf([]any{}), want: "foo.com bar.com"},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := stringToStringSliceHookFunc(reflect.TypeOf(tt.input), tt.target, tt.input)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
+		})

+}
